### ChaeSong-hwa's Suggestion for the Garden

Upon completion of the garden renovation and all its features, ChaeSong-hwa envisions the space being used for community gatherings. She believes that the garden should not only serve as a beautiful and relaxing place but also as a venue for bringing people together and fostering connections. ChaeSong-hwa expresses enthusiasm for the idea of people arranging gatherings there, which would allow them to celebrate the fruition of their collective hard work and enjoy the new green space. Such gatherings could include various activities and are seen as a means to close the community gap, making the garden a true communal hub.

---

This summary encapsulates ChaeSong-hwa's idea for future community engagements in the newly refurbished garden after its completion. Her proposal aligns with the collaborative and inclusive spirit already present among the group members working on the garden project.
